apply_by.description: When exceeded: the day to apply to register by (sg-deadlines).

entries.description: How many posted entries make the figure; a void counts as its own.

exceeded.description: true when it is more than the threshold.

registered_from.description: When exceeded: the day the registration would start (sg-deadlines).

taxable_supplies.description: The taxable supplies posted in it (design D3): the lines of invoices, credit notes and bank transactions coded for Box 1 or Box 2, on accounts that are not assets, in Singapore dollars.

to.description: Its last day, or today while it runs.

unmatched.description: Documents whose entry's lines did not match their lines, so their codes could not be read: left out, and named on C.1 #37.
